'''Ormo Haddon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]], who was the [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the reign of [[Darth Krayt]]. The new [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] had restricted the sale of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas to non-government entities, which resulted in many small operations moving out of Cloud City. As a result, it became a darker and more dangerous place. With much of the [[City/Legends|city]] abandoned, Ormo Haddon had moved the business and entertaining areas to the center of the city, leaving its outskirts abandoned and completely lawless.<ref name="LECG" />
